agency: Nevada Division of Social Services (DSS) — renamed from the Division of Welfare and Supportive Services (DWSS); legacy "dwss.nv.gov" paths still appear throughout the agency's own site assets
admin_note: State-administered: DSS runs SNAP directly through DSS district offices; there is no independent county eligibility agency layer. SNAP, TANF, and related programs share ONE combined manual — the Eligibility and Payments (E&P) Manual — organized into Part A (Determining Eligibility, chapters 100–2600), Part B (Case Management, chapters 100–1400), and Part C (Charts/dollar tables, chapters 100–300), amended by numbered Manual Transmittal Letters (MTLs, e.g. "MTL 21/25"). Because Parts A/B/C are shared with TANF, most sections print a two-column TANF/SNAP layout — this pack only draws from the SNAP column or SNAP-only sections.
system: AMPS (worker-facing eligibility system, referenced in manual text); EBT is simply branded "EBT card", accessed at ebtedge.com

update_channels.name: Eligibility and Payments (E&P) Manual — Parts A/B/C, amended by numbered Manual Transmittal Letters (MTLs)

verification.method: Direct fetch of ~10 E&P Manual chapter PDFs (Parts A, B, C) over plain curl and browser-header curl (dss.nv.gov/siteassets/... — no host blocking observed) → pdftotext extraction → cross-read against the Nevada Legislature's own codified NRS text (leg.state.nv.us, plain curl) and a live FNS ABAWD waiver-response letter and the FNS national Restaurant Meals Program page → draft → adversarial refute gate. No packages/snap-rules NV entry existed to cross-check against (confirmed absent — see PROVENANCE.md).
verification.gates: Cross-check: every pivotal dollar value and eligibility rule traced to its own E&P Manual chapter PDF (never a curated extract) before drafting; the drug-felony opt-out was independently corroborated against the raw NRS 422A.345 HTML (not just a legal-summary site) after a secondary source described conflicting (pre-2021) statutory language. Refute gate recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
